approval_user_message: 请你继续执行后续的实验和整理 提升我们的模型效果
outer_validation: Same seven v5 LeaveOneGroupOut folds, six fitting rooms and one scoring room
inner_selection: Use only saved v5 3-fold grouped inner OOF predictions on six outer-fitting rooms, with the already inner-selected per-formulation RF candidates. Choose weight minimizing equal-room original-unit MAE. Exact ties prefer larger w.
scope_of_inner_scores: Selection scores reuse the same inner data for candidate and weight selection; they are not an unbiased performance estimate. Outer room is used for scoring only.
no_room_routing: One scalar w per training fold, constant for all hours and angles of the held-out room; no room-specific post-hoc rules
stopping_rule: If the gate fails, retain A and stop expanding weights/routing models without new independently available input information. No finer or room-specific search after observing outer results.
scope: Approved bounded fusion development experiment. Seven rooms previously used for model development; no independent final TEST evidence, no deployment refit, no new simulations. Preserve all previous experiments.
